newsitem.title: USA: Thermo Remediation unit wins contracts.
newsitem.headline: Thermo Remediation unit wins contracts.

text.p: Thermo Remediation Inc's IEM Sealand subsidiary won three separate contracts totaling $4.1 million, the company said Tuesday.
It won a $2.2 million deal to close an 18-acre landfill for the town of West Lebanon, New Hampshire and a $950,000 contract for a similar landfill-closure for the town of Bristol, Rhode Island.

A third contract, worth $990,000, was awarded under a U.S. Environmental Protection Agency program. The contract is for soil-remediation and restoration services at part of the Carson River Mercury Superfund site in Carson City, Nevada.

The contaminated area encompasses more than three acres of mostly residential property containing various levels of mercury left behind by a mining mill that occupied the site in the late 1800s, the company said.
